_about: Open questions for native-speaker translation review, read by scripts/export_translation_review.py.
locales.<locale>.<key>: the question shown in the review sheet's flag column; locales['*'] applies to every locale.
Keys are resource names (a <plurals> name flags all its items). Sources: docs/i18n/2026-09-29-hardcoded-ui-sweep.md translator notes and memory/HANDOFF.md section -2.
Remove an entry once a native reviewer has answered it.

*.ime_default_prompt_toast: Names Android system-settings screens; check it matches the phone's own wording in this language.
*.swipe_debug_session_intro: Screen name 'Swipe Playground': translate or keep English?
